reuse.why: Uses existing setBudget, getSheetValue, getCategoryAverage/setNMonthAvg, batchMessages, isTrackingBudget and the shared extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag instead of a hand-written tag parser.

duplication.why: The four copies of the category query and the per-action income/hidden checks are collapsed into one getMonthActionCategories helper used by every month-wide action, including the new one.

placement.why: Selection helper, new action and handler registration live in budget/actions.ts and budget/app.ts next to the existing month-wide actions.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their selection rule, the new method registration and tests are touched; single-category actions are unchanged.

maintainability.why: One documented eligibility function with a single named option and a shared MonthActionArgs type makes future rules a one-place edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) route through getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No residual copies; copyPreviousMonth filters its budget rows by the shared eligible-id set rather than re-checking hidden/income itself.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains only the requested includeHiddenCategories option (implemented as the SQL hidden filter); #fixed and template rules were folded into the same helper rather than branched per caller.
